# Attribution

This profile adapts action names and bounded rules concepts from the
**System Reference Document 5.2.1** by Wizards of the Coast LLC, licensed under
**Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)**.

Source: https://www.dndbeyond.com/srd

License text: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode

The Five E Commons action identities, resolver classifications, equipment
contracts, and CosyWorld deltas are modified material authored by Cenetex. The
complete source attribution and unmodified reference records remain in the
independently versioned `cosyworld.rules-srd-5.2.1` reference pack.
